children: There are not many in the galaxy that can say they captured a Sith Lord alive. Far fewer can say they captured not only a Sith Lord but two of the greatest Jedi of
. Only Hondo Ohnaka can say that he, and his pirate crew, did that not once, but twice. The

pirate captain had a mix of traits that served him well but were also his undoing. He was very cunning and when he had the upper hand in a situation he took advantage of it. This included changing deals to suit his goal of making money to using a concoction to knock out those who thought they were his allies.
His greed and scheming ways rubbed off on his crew and affected his plans at the worst possible times. After capturing

and attempting to ransom them, his plans fell apart due to the back-stabbing nature of his crew. However, he was not ruthless and seemed to operate under his own code of honor. The escaped Jedi captured the pirate captain but freed him after they realized that Dooku had already gotten away. Hondo in return told his men not to harm the Jedi and allowed them to go their way.
